comparisons.peer_summary: Selling, general and administrative expense increased $3,367 million, or 211%, in fiscal year 2024 compared to the prior year, primarily due to higher compensation resulting from increased headcount from the VMware Merger and higher grant-date fair values of annual employee equity awards.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom report significant increases in their respective general and administrative operating expenses for fiscal year 2024. AMD attributes its $431 million (18%) increase in Marketing, General and Administrative (MG&A) expenses to 'go-to-market activities,' whereas Broadcom reports a much larger absolute and percentage increase ($3,367 million, 211%) in SG&A, driven specifically by 'higher compensation' and headcount growth from the VMware Merger. While both companies cite employee-related costs as a factor, the primary driver for AMD is activity level expansion for revenue growth, while Broadcom's is structural cost integration from an acquisition.

sentences.text: Marketing, general and administrative expenses of $2.8 billion in 2024 increased by $431 million, or 18%, compared to $2.4 billion in 2023.
The increase was primarily due to an increase in go-to-market activities to support our revenue growth.
Selling, general and administrative expense increased $3,367 million, or 211%, in fiscal year 2024, compared to the prior fiscal year.
The increase was primarily due to higher compensation, including higher stock-based compensation, as a result of an increase in headcount from the VMware Merger.

peer_results.rationale: Intel's candidate disclosures focus on 'Operating expenses' driven by 'process technology investments' and 'All other operating expenses' being flat. The 'All other operating expenses' topic is too distinct and lacks the specific MG&A/SG&A comparative detail found in the target.

comparisons.peer_summary: SG&A expenses increased 23% in 2024 compared to 2023 primarily due to higher employee compensation, whereas 2023 expenses were 14% lower than 2022 due to decreases in compensation, legal fees, advertising, and professional services.
comparisons.comparison: AMD and Micron both disclose increases in their general and administrative expenses for 2024, with both citing employee compensation as a key driver. AMD's MG&A expenses increased by 18% to $2.8 billion, primarily due to 'go-to-market activities.' Micron's SG&A expenses increased by 23%, primarily due to an 'increase in employee compensation.' Although AMD frames the expense increase around business activity expansion and Micron around compensation specifically, both reflect similar cost pressures in their general operating expense lines related to 2024 growth and staffing.
